textRuns.value: This table lists every tenancy that started on or before the last day of the selected Financial Year, with one row for each financial year the tenancy spans, up to and including the selected year. The Financial Year, Owner, Program, Gender and Ethnicity selections made on the Summary page carry over to this page. The Average at the bottom of the "Tenancy Length (Days)" column matches All Time Avg Length of Tenancy on the Summary page, unless a chart on the Summary page was clicked to cross-filter it. The "Tenancy Start Date in FY" and "Tenancy End Date in FY" columns show the part of each tenancy that falls in that FY, and "Tenancy Length (Days)" counts the days from the actual start date to the end date in that FY. The "Actual" columns show the true beginning and end date of the tenancy.
If you have a slicer on Gender or Ethnicity, please be aware that this only applies to the
tenant and in some cases may not be useful.
